testnetCompromise: Base Sepolia has exactly ONE Chainlink feed per pair, so the >=3-source constructor floor is met by deploying three ChainlinkSourceAdapter instances over the same canonical feed (distinct source addresses). This satisfies the OracleAggregator constructor mechanically but NOT the SF-1 mechanism-diversity listing criterion, and M-1's distinctness check cannot catch it either: the ADDRESSES differ, the upstream feed does not. Quorum is 3-of-3 since the H-1 remediation (quorum must reach MIN_MEDIAN=3, because a 2-element lower median is a minimum); on this testnet that costs nothing, as all three adapters read one feed and fail together anyway. A mainnet config MUST list >=5 sources per asset with quorum 3 - see base-mainnet.json oracleRemediationRequired.

smoke.minDepositNote: 1 USDC is a TESTNET SMOKE value, kept small so the smoke lifecycle stays cheap; the deployed Base Sepolia smoke vault already uses it. A PRODUCTION vault must set minDepositUsdc to an economically meaningful value (see base-mainnet.json minDepositNote and AI-AUDIT-REPORT.md H-8): the <5-member signer quorum regime is stake-blind, so a 1-USDC seat lets an attacker buy the regime flip or grief a small vault into ungovernability. Documented listing constraint, not a contract floor (M-6 shape).
smoke.govDefencesNote: M-6: these three were 0 / 10000 / 0 — i.e. the reference configuration shipped with every named CM-6/VO-5 defence DISABLED. proposalThresholdBps 0 let anyone holding one unit open proposals (the precondition M-7 and C-1 both rely on); concentrationCapBps 10000 let a single delegate carry 100% of snapshot stake, so one live participant plus a permissionless cranker manufactured full quorum from offline delegators, defeating VO-2 outright; proposalCooldown was not validated by the contract AT ALL. Governance._validateConfig now enforces a 100 bps threshold floor, a 5000 bps concentration ceiling, and a proposalCooldown in [1 hour, 30 days] — the upper bound because an unvalidated uint32 cooldown is C-2's shape on a field C-2 did not cover.
smoke.govTestnetNote: Set AT the contract floors here, unlike base-mainnet.json which sits deliberately above them. A testnet smoke run wants the least friction that is still legal; mainnet capital wants margin.
